findings.description:
R3 closed the row-level pass-over-failure hole, but body_consistency() still does not re-derive the composer's ENVIRONMENT preconditions that compose_verdict() treats as hard failures. Observed (tip 6ec3ea43, artifacts under /tmp):

1) Built a genuine composer report with MeasurementContext(scope_adapter='degraded', index_tier='live', code_search_enabled=True, ... ) through compose_verdict + build_report (same construction as test_enablement_gate_mutation._document). Output: verdict='fail', fail_reasons=['apparatus_failure'], environment.scope_adapter='degraded', ALL four gates verdict='pass', all 19 cases scored. body_consistency(apparatus) -> BodyConsistency(derived_verdict='pass', recorded_verdict='fail', contradictions=(), body_failures=()) — consistent by design of one-way.

2) Two-field hand-edit of that document only: verdict fail->pass, delete fail_reasons. body_consistency(forged).consistent=True, derived=pass, recorded=pass; report.validate_report(forged) accepted. Then enablement_gate.main([--repository-root <wt>, --semantic-context <tmp with INJECTION_DEFAULT_ENABLED True>, --report <forged>, --corpus packages/context-eval/corpus, --embedding-contract <matching fingerprint>]) printed every condition met, including verdict_consistent ('the recorded verdict 'pass' is the one this body composes to') and verdict_pass, and returned exit 0.

3) Same class for SERVICE_DISABLED: composer with code_search_enabled=False fails live-tier gates with service_disabled_during_measurement. Flipping those gates to pass (and top-level to pass), leaving environment.code_search_enabled=false, yields body_consistency.consistent=True, schema_valid, and gate exit 0. body_consistency checks _tier_satisfies for pass gates but never reads environment.code_search_enabled against min_index_tier=='live', and never treats environment.scope_adapter=='degraded' as a body failure.

This is the same category error as R1/R2: the authorizing field is still not fully re-derived from everything the composer uses. It is NOT the accepted full-forgery limitation (no invented arms/metrics needed) — it is a two-field edit of a composer-produced apparatus_failure report, or a one-field flip of scope_adapter on a genuine pass. The one-way justification is valid for truly body-invisible cases (e.g. undeclared-case denominator mismatch dropped from the case list), but is wrong as written for apparatus_failure/service_disabled: both preconditions are already recorded in document['environment'] and are body-visible. The 7-entry CONTRADICTIONS corpus never includes a degraded-adapter or service-disabled document, so verdict_consistent is mutation-proven only for row-level contradictions.

Controls on the same tree: unmodified make semantic-enablement-gate exit 0; composer-produced full pass authorizes (exit 0) — no over-refusal of legitimate pass; R2 three-field edit of committed report still yields ~19 schema errors and body_consistency False; 360 context-eval tests pass; harness fingerprint recorded==computed; --harness-version/--harness-source rejected by argparse.
findings.resolution: Extend body_consistency() (and the CONTRADICTIONS corpus) so environment preconditions that compose_verdict fails on are re-derived from the document: (1) if environment.scope_adapter == 'degraded', treat that as a body failure (or a contradiction when recorded verdict is pass) — apparatus_failure is then body-visible and a two-field flip of an apparatus report must set consistent=False and refuse enablement; (2) for every gate with verdict pass and min_index_tier == 'live', if environment.code_search_enabled is not true, append a contradiction (mirroring SERVICE_DISABLED_DURING_MEASUREMENT). Keep one-way only for fail reasons that truly cannot appear in rows after emission (document if any remain). Add mutation cases: (a) genuine apparatus report with only verdict+fail_reasons flipped; (b) pass body with scope_adapter set to degraded; (c) pass body with code_search_enabled false — assert enablement_gate.main(...) != 0 and body_consistency not consistent. Do not re-score measured vs thresholds here (still accepted forgery class).
